findings.claim: Q3 2026 專業服務及其他營收 $17.3M、年減3%，因技術顧問服務減少、Payments 費用部分抵銷；總營收年增17%
findings.excerpt: Professional services and other revenue decreased during the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to the same period in 2025 due to lower revenue from technical consulting services, partially offset by fees earned from Payments.
Grew Customers to 311,704 as of September 30, 2026, up 12%. Average Subscription Revenue Per Customer was $12,038 during the third quarter of 2026, up 4% on an as-reported basis.

findings.source: HubSpot Q3 2026 8-K ex99.1（搜尋摘要轉述）
